mapper.sql: select t.*, s.supplier_name as supplier_name, u2.nick_name as owner_name from erp_contract t left join erp_supplier s on s.id = t.supplier_id left join sys_user u2 on u2.user_id = t.owner_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_contract (contract_no, contract_name, supplier_id, start_date, end_date, contract_amount, currency, payment_terms, contract_status, owner_id, signed_date, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{supplierId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{contractAmount}, #{currency}, #{paymentTerms}, #{contractStatus}, #{ownerId}, #{signedDate}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_contract where id in #{id}
